types.definition: A feature's position read relative to a reference: moving across a series or condition (shift), OR offset/overlap against a feature of another species or quantity on the same axis (emission vs absorption band, emission vs photonic stopband, band edge vs source spectrum). Direction, magnitude and reference feature in attrs
types.why_not_existing: The v02 leaves have no home for a band-position reading against a different species' band. feature_assignment maps a feature to its origin, and reference_match compares a whole pattern with the same quantity. Broadening feature_shift is a better fit than adding a sibling, because the read feature is the same (position) and only the reference differs; attrs.aspect = overlap marks it

rels.definition: Also allow src = a claim node (PRP/MEC/PRF) when dst = DES/down_select
rels.why: DES/down_select is defined as a decision made because of an observation, but in practice the decision rests on a weighed claim (a trade-off MEC) rather than a single OBS. v02 lists only HYP/DSC/OBS as motivates sources, so the spine edge MEC/tradeoff -> DES/down_select has no legal rel. supports is claim->claim and realizes is DES->PRC. Without this extension the spine breaks at every screen-then-choose paper

mm_ops.name: assess_feature_overlap
mm_ops.definition: Judge whether features of two DIFFERENT quantities or species coincide in position along a shared axis (spectral overlap of donor emission and acceptor absorption; emission band vs photonic stopband or plasmon resonance; absorption edge vs source spectrum; band-edge alignment), and how a shift changes that overlap. The overlap is the premise for a coupling mechanism (energy transfer, resonance, filtering, charge transfer). Failure modes: peak coincidence taken for overlap integral; shift judged without regard to bandwidth
mm_ops.why_not_existing: compare_coplotted_quantities judges relative magnitude or dominance on shared axes, not positional coincidence. match_to_reference judges whether the SAME quantity matches a reference (identity). track_feature_across_series follows one feature through a series. Here, positions of two different quantities are set against each other and the conclusion is a coupling condition (MEC), not identity, dominance or trend. The next inference differs, and so does the audit: in F5d a ~10 nm shift of a ~100 nm-wide band against a ~20 nm stopband is too small to carry the claimed 40x vs 6x differential. General to FRET/photoswitch systems, plasmonic and photonic enhancement, photocatalyst absorption vs solar spectrum, and heterojunction band alignment

comments: 1) One mm_op only, with evidence from one paper but two figures. It is a real gap: every optical-coupling argument (FRET, photonic/plasmonic enhancement, sensitisation) rests on this reading, and none of the 7 compare ops licenses a coupling mechanism. If the judge wants to shrink the compare family, the alternative is to broaden compare_coplotted_quantities to 'magnitude OR positional overlap' with attrs.aspect. I argue against that: dominance and overlap lead to different MEC types (partition vs pathway). 2) Boundary rule request, no new type (biological papers, 3 of 4 here): in-vitro cell response measured against a material design variable = PRP/value (property_family biological); in-vivo application endpoint (closure, wound strength, bone repair) = PRF/service_capability; in-vivo host-tissue biomarkers (SOD, collagen content, histology scores) have no clean home. I typed them PRP/value + attrs.object='treated wound tissue', fit=poor (Biomaterials 2013 d13, d14). They are properties of the host, not the material, but a new type would change no inference, because they bridge release -> performance just as PRP does. I suggest a note in the PRP definition: attrs.object may be the host tissue in biomedical in-vivo studies. 3) Attr convention: I used property_family=chemical_corrosion for hydrolytic and enzymatic polymer biodegradation (Bioactive b12; chitosan c11-c13). Please confirm, or add 'biodegradation' to the chemical_corrosion note, so staff do not split it across biological, kinetic and chemical_corrosion. 4) Poor fits deliberately not proposed: mesoscale colloidal crystal fcc/(111) as STR/phase/identity (AM a9); polymer crystallinity as STR/phase/fraction (chitosan c10); a physical gel network as STR/microstructure/porosity (d9); micelle self-assembly as PRC/synthesis (d6); in-situ gelation on the wound as PRC/forming (d7); DLS size distribution as OBS/response/characteristic_value (d23; if another staff member's OBS/response/distribution proposal is accepted, d23 should migrate there). Each has one instance, and attrs carry the difference. 5) Multimodal notes for the judge: TEM vs DLS size in Biomaterials 2013 F1 (d24 contradicts: ~10 nm dots vs 26.9 nm claimed agreement), handled with cross_check_consistency on a contrasts edge. Chitosan F4: the adhesion series is flat while viability collapses (c31 text_silent), which undercuts the paper's adhesion mechanism. Bioactive F9: quantitative bars exist only for the chosen scaffold, so the between-group claim rests on unlabelled micro-CT renders (b39/b40 partial). 6) Audit nodes per paper: AM 0, Bioactive 1 (b32 pH), chitosan 1 (c31), curcumin 1 (d35). Everything else is in image_note/image_support.
